items.quote: Moses besought the LORD his God, and said
items.claim: Moses appealed to God seeking His favor

items.quote: which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand
items.claim: God brought the Israelite people forth out of Egypt using great power and a mighty hand
items.mechanism: great power, with a mighty hand

items.quote: For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth
items.claim: The Egyptians might claim God maliciously brought the Israelites out in order to slay them
items.action: bring them out, slay them, consume them

items.quote: thy wrath wax hot against thy people
items.claim: God's wrath was kindled against the Israelite people
